newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury launch Astros, to take on Smarties.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury launch Astros, to take on Smarties.

text.p: Britain's soft drinks to chocolate group Cadbury Schweppes PlC said on Wednesday it will launch a chocolate covered shell called Astros throughout Britain from August 25.
Astros, which will compete with Nestle SA owned Smarties, were first launched in South Africa two years ago.
The launch campaign will cost six million pounds and include using Cadbury's sponsorship credit of the popular television soap opera Coronation Street.

Cadbury has more than a 30 percent share of the UK market where consumers spent a record 3.4 billion pounds on chocolate last year. Britons eat more per head than any country in the world except the Swiss.
Astros are aimed at meeting the demand for nibbling whilst busy doing something else, said the company in a statement.
